snippet.title: Starship Home - Official Accolades Trailer | Creature Feature Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Traverse the galaxy in a starship bound for discovery with Starship Home. Prepare your living room for lift off as you depart on an interplanetary expedition to collect, nurture, and befriend plants from around the galaxy. Immerse yourself in the mystery of an interstellar crisis from the comfort of your own home. Starship Home is available now for Meta Quest.

#VR #IGN #Gaming
